vehicle: SLS Block 1B (first crewed flight, Exploration Upper Stage) + Starship HLS (lunar lander)
payload: Orion + 4-person crew; I-HAB (International Habitation module) delivered to the Lunar Gateway
credit: © NASA — Artemis IV. First crewed mission to the Lunar Gateway: SLS Block 1B debuts the Exploration Upper Stage (EUS), launching Orion + crew and co-manifesting the ESA/JAXA-built I-HAB (International Habitation) module for delivery to Gateway. The mission conducts the second crewed lunar landing via a Starship HLS. Planned ~2028; crew and landing site TBD.
